### Challenged to Boast like a Christian
Author: Erik Raymond
Site: The Gospel Coalition
URL: https://www.thegospelcoalition.org/blogs/erik-raymond/challenged-to-boast-like-a-christian/
Passage: Galatians 6:14
Points:
- Standing in the shadow of the cross leaves no room for personal pride or self-merit.
- True Christian boasting rejoices solely in the grace revealed at Calvary.
- Believers naturally boast in the cross when their minds delight in Christ rather than worldly pursuits.
- Fixating on self and temporary things shifts our affections away from Jesus.
- Believers must calibrate their desires and wills through Christ's sacrifice so He is magnified.
